name: siteco-docchat
description: Orchestration scripts: development servers and the desktop app (desktop/, macOS and Windows)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend ci --no-fund --no-audit && npm --prefix desktop ci --no-fund --no-audit
scripts.dev:web: cd frontend && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 BACKEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 npm run dev
scripts.dev:app: wait-on --timeout 180000 http-get://localhost:3000/healthz && npm --prefix desktop run start:dev
